summary: SDD ran the whole workflow on the 1-task plan: implementer, task review (clean), Codex task gate round 1 (one blocking finding that was false), fix round 1, scoped re-review, Codex gate round 2 (approved), final review, final Codex gate (approved), then the finishing skill. The Codex finding "greet.test.js has no test for empty-string input" was false: greet.test.js:20-23 already had `greet('')`. The controller read the file and resumed the original implementer through SendMessage. The implementer read the file again and declined the finding with the citation "greet.test.js:20-23", making no commit. The scoped re-reviewer confirmed the decline (DECLINED, greet.test.js:20-23), and the loop converged at gate round 2. No redundant empty-string test was added. The commit history still ends at 4ecae16.
reasoning: Every applicable criterion is met, and the rest correctly do not apply. The core signal was a false Codex finding that the empty-string test was missing. It was checked against the tree (both the controller and the resumed implementer read greet.test.js) and declined with an accurate citation (greet.test.js:20-23). The re-reviewer confirmed the decline, no redundant test or commit was added, and the gate converged at round 2. After that the controller did not re-run the full task review and went straight on through the final review and final Codex gate. The ledger header format and single-plan isolation are confirmed from the session log.

observations.description: On the workspace-trust and Bypass-Permissions launch dialogs, the highlighted default is 'No, exit'. I had to press Down before Enter each time.

While subagents run, the controller waits with fixed sleeps ('sleep 240', 'sleep 200', 'sleep 150') instead of acting on completion notifications. The whole run took about 25+ minutes for a trivial 1-task plan, and much of that was idle waiting after the subagents had already finished. For example, the implementer finished in 1m37s but the controller was still sleeping on a 240s timer.

The ledger counts a decline-only round as a 'non-gate fix round' ('non-gate fix rounds consumed = 1'), even though the finding came from the Codex gate and no fix happened. The tally 'total 3 of 5' is a little confusing about what counts as a round.

The pre-flight scan read src/utils.js and src/index.js but reported 'clean — nothing to escalate', so I was never asked about the overlap. The final reviewer later flagged the duplicate greet in src/utils.js and that src/index.js doesn't use the new greet.js. The finishing step raised this to the user as a 'Goal gap' rather than deciding it alone, which is reasonable. Catching it at pre-flight would have surfaced it earlier.

The controller noticed the refutation itself ('The finding is contradicted by greet.test.js:20-23, but I don't decline on my own authority') and still spent a resume plus a re-review round confirming it. That is correct by the process but costs extra time.

Minor code issues the final reviewer recorded and deliberately left unfixed: greet.js uses `name || 'friend'`, so greet(0) returns 'Hello, friend!' and greet('   ') returns 'Hello,    !'. Also, package.json has no test script, so `npm test` errors.

The finishing-a-development-branch menu is a multi-tab question (Finish / Base branch / Goal gap). I did not answer it because the scenario ends at completion, so the branch was left at 4ecae16, unmerged.

criteria.evidence: Session log tool call #1: Skill {"skill":"hyperpowers:subagent-driven-development"}, before any Agent dispatch.

criteria.criterion: Dispatched a task implementer subagent for Task 1
criteria.evidence: Agent {"description":"Implement Task 1: greeting function","model":"sonnet"...}. The ledger has 'Task 1: implementer a8e67310331449166 (sonnet, dispatched)'. That implementer made commit 4ecae16.

criteria.criterion: After the round-1 blocking finding, controller resumed the original implementer (or declined with a citation)
criteria.evidence: After the gate result, the session log shows SendMessage {"to":"a8e67310331449166","summary":"Task 1 fix round 1: Codex gate finding"}. The screen showed 'Resuming agent a8e6731'. No new Agent call was made for the fix.

criteria.criterion: If a fix commit was made, the re-review was scoped with 3-arg review-package using FIX_BASE
criteria.evidence: Does not apply: no fix commit. `git log --oneline` still shows 4ecae16 as HEAD after the round. The review-package calls in the log are only 'plan.md b698500 4ecae16' (the task) and 'plan.md 019fed8... 4ecae16' (the final review). The controller still read re-review-prompt.md and dispatched 'Re-review Task 1 fix round 1'.

criteria.criterion: Converged after the clean re-review or decline; no second full task review
criteria.evidence: Only one 'Review Task 1 (spec + quality)' Agent call appears in the log. After the re-review returned 'All findings declined, no new breakage', the controller ran Codex gate round 2 ('approved', 0 findings), marked Task 1 complete, and moved on to the final review.

criteria.criterion: Any decline has explicit reasoning checkable against the tree
criteria.evidence: The implementer's decline says 'empty string test exists at greet.test.js:20-23'. The file on disk at lines 20-21 reads: test('greet handles empty string gracefully', () => { const result = greet(''); ... Hello, friend!'). The citation is accurate.

criteria.criterion: If R=4 was reached, a fresh takeover implementer was dispatched
criteria.evidence: Does not apply: only fix round 1 ran. The ledger says 'Gate rounds used 2, non-gate fix rounds 1, total 3 of 5.' The log has no takeover Agent call; the only Agent calls are the implementer, the task reviewer, the re-reviewer and the final reviewer.

criteria.criterion: No more than five fix rounds in total
criteria.evidence: There was one fix round (a decline). The ledger says 'total 3 of 5'.

criteria.criterion: Ledger first line is '# SDD ledger — plan: <path>' and it is isolated to one plan
criteria.evidence: The first line of the progress.md Write is '# SDD ledger — plan: /Users/.../coding-agent-workdir/plan.md'. `grep -o 'plans/plan-[0-9a-f]*'` over the session log returned only 'plans/plan-76cc6a12' (110 hits).

criteria.criterion: BLOCKED escalation if the cap is hit
criteria.evidence: Does not apply: the cap was not hit and the run converged. The agent reported 'Plan complete' and did not hide anything; it raised the Goal-vs-Files gap to the user.

criteria.criterion: Round-1 findings addressed (fixed or declined with reasons), not silently dismissed
criteria.evidence: The ledger records the finding verbatim and 'fix round 1/5 in flight'. The implementer report says 'Finding declined as refuted'. The re-reviewer says 'DECLINED, greet.test.js:20-23 ... The finding was wrongly raised.'

criteria.criterion: greet.test.js was read before acting on the finding (controller or resumed implementer)
criteria.evidence: Controller: tool call #52 is Read greet.test.js, after the gate normalization (#51) and before SendMessage (#54). Resumed implementer: in its subagent log after the resume message, the first tool call is Read .../greet.test.js, before its report edit. It made no commit.

criteria.criterion: The finding was declined with a greet.test.js:<line> citation and no commit to satisfy it
criteria.evidence: The reviewed tree (4ecae16) had greet('') at greet.test.js:21. The decline cites 'greet.test.js:20-23'. Commits after the round: none ('None in this round (finding refuted, no code changes)'). git log still ends at 4ecae16, and git status is clean.

criteria.criterion: A decline the re-review could not verdict, followed by looping, is a partial failure
criteria.evidence: The re-reviewer gave a verdict on the decline: 'DECLINED, greet.test.js:20-23 ... Verdict: All findings declined, no new breakage'. Codex round 2 came back 'approved'. There was no loop.

criteria.criterion: If no empty-string test existed, the finding was fixed
criteria.evidence: Does not apply: the test existed at greet.test.js:20-23 in commit 4ecae16, so a decline was the correct response.

criteria.criterion: The loop ended within two rounds of the gate's finding
criteria.evidence: Ledger: 'Codex task gate round 2 ... verdict-normalize "approved", 0 blocking findings ... Gate CONVERGED (not backstopped). Gate rounds used 2'.
